params.name: id
params.description: This information must be obtained from the response of the 'Modalities' service,

params.name: modality
params.description: Modality chosen by the user; this information must be obtained from the detail service response, in the structure: 'modalities' -> 'id'.

params.name: date
params.description: Date on which the activity will take place; the format to send is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: site
params.description: Refers to the country code; it must contain two alphabetic characters

params.name: language
params.description: This field must be filled with the language in which you want to receive the response

params.name: additionals
params.description: Refers to the ID of the additional attraction; this information must be obtained from the response of the 'Modalities' service, field 'id' within the 'additionals' structure.

params.name: distribution
params.description: In this field, send the distribution of people in the activity. The first position always refers to the number of adults; the remaining positions should be the ages of the minors (children or infants).Example: for an activity with 2 adults, two 8-year-olds, and two 4-year-olds

params.name: schedule
params.description: In this field, send the distribution of people in the activity. The first position always refers to the number of adults; the remaining positions should be the ages of the minors (children or infants).Example: for an activity with 2 adults, two 8-year-olds, and two 4-year-olds

params.name: hotel_id
params.description: Refers to the id of the hotel.

params.name: country_code
params.description: Refers to the country code, which must be filled with two alphabetical digits.

params.name: checkin_date
params.description: Refers to the hotel check-in date and must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: checkout_date
params.description: Refers to the hotel check-out date and must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: currency
params.description: Refers to the currency, which must be filled with three alphabetical digits. (E.g. "USD", "ARS")

params.name: distribution
params.description: Passenger distribution. Each room’s passengers should be written as number_of_adults-children_ages. Children-age goes up to 17 years old. Rooms should be separated by “!”. E.g.: Means room 1 with 2 adults and room 2 with 2 adults and a 10-year-old child.

params.name: language
params.description: Refers to the language, which must be filled with two alphabetical digits.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Maximum time allowed for the connection. Minimum = 3000 ms, Maximum = 6200 ms.

params.name: refundable_only
params.description: If set to ‘true’, only refundable hotel rates will be quoted.

items.docs: Returns live availability for a specific hotel.
